description: Nesting-depth boundary of the canonical JSON writer (docs/SCHEMA.md §3.4 rule 2): 1000 nested array/map levels encode, 1001 are rejected. Only the writer side is pinned for JSON: the Java reference reader delegates document parsing to Jackson, whose own document-nesting constraint fires at the same magnitude as rule 2 and is not the rule (see vectors/README.md, documented leniencies). The schemas are given as generatedSchema (see vectors/README.md).

vectors.description: 1000 nested single-element arrays around an int encode: exactly at the limit, which §3.4 rule 2 must accept.
1001 nested arrays exceed the 1000-level limit and are rejected before any byte is written.
